releaseNotes: New first-use guided tutorial after onboarding: My Week, All Recipes, My Recipes, Shopping List and Settings.
Dimmed overlays keep the relevant controls highlighted, with clear Next, Skip and Finish actions.
Existing households are not interrupted; the tutorial can be replayed from Settings at any time.
Responsive walkthrough layout for compact phones, tablets and landscape, with keyboard support and Android Back dismissal.
Your meals, favourites, cupboard inventory and shopping checks remain unchanged during this update.
